quest.title: Dancin' in the Moonlight
quest.description: When that moon's big and bright, it's a fine, natural sight that's a supernatural delight...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

talks.objective: Go to the location of Magnifico's photoshoot

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Now I thought I heard people talking about me — but I never expected it to be you! Hah, what a coincidence!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Guess we forgot you have a hot-air balloon, huh? Not that you've ever brought us along on it, you stingy...!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawoo! Rawoo!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Well, you've never asked, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And why would we... Ugh, you never told us, so how would we know that asking was even an option!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: #A pleasure to meet you all again, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, and dear little Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: See, I knew we'd meet again! Just in time, too — there's something I need your help with.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Here? Is it something tricky?

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Not too much trouble, really. You'll find out in a jiffy!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Magnifico leaps nimbly from his hot-air balloon and retrieves his Film Kamera and tripod from his luggage, assembling them in an open space.\nHe soon finishes his work and stands before you proudly.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Hehe, either way, do make way. I'm about to make landfall!

talks.objective: Go to the location of Magnifico's photoshoot

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Ker-chak! Behold, a miracle of light and shadow — Fontaine's latest industrial achievement!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? That's nothing new to us. Also, you haven't told us what you need help with yet!

choices.text: Yes, just come out with it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From the looks of it, you probably want us to help you take a photo, right?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Oh... Well, sure! Here's your deposit. Please take it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait. This is a ton of Mora!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wrraa!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: As you have seen, I need to take a few pictures of Saurians, and I'm not talking about one of those three-view drawings you see in animal illustration books either... What I'm going for is something full of vitality!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—Yeah, okay!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: But on the other hand... more vitality means "less likely to listen to me." So, if it's convenient, could you dear adventurers please help me take the ideal pictures I need?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—Yeah, okay!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Of course, you don't have to force yourself to do things beyond your ability, but I suspect you could at least protect me from hostile life forms.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: So please, keep the deposit... and as for whether to help or not, I'll leave that decision to you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa... All this money's making this bag super heavy... You sure it's all ours?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Come on, you think I'd deceive you? Or should I double-check the sum for you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe... Hahaha! Well, looks like you've come to the right people, because Paimon is a renowned Saurian tamer here in Natlan!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Don'cha worry. So long as {NICKNAME} and Paimon are here, any Saurian you wish to tame will be tamed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tepetlisaurs? Easy-peasy? Qucusaurs? Cheddar-cheesy! Iktomisaurs? Lemon-squeezy... Uh, we also do Koholasaurs, Yumkasaurs, Tachankasaurs...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Bigheadasaurs, Miniarmasaurs, Gigagogglesaurs, Scarysaurs, Superscarysaurs, Somewhatscarysaurs, Weirdosaurs, Normiesaurs, Skinnysaurs, Hulkasaurs...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hoohroo!

choices.text: What are you talking about, Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And... the Rawoorasaurs!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawoo, rawoo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And the Wraahrasaurs!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wraah! Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, you name 'em, we can handle 'em!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hrrm, Hrmm!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Of course we will. We've already taken a deposit of that size, after all! Right, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Ah, wonderful. Wonderful!

choices.text: Sorry, I've got things to do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But we've already taken the deposit...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Ha, it's fine. Just wait till you have the time! It's not like I'll melt into a helpless puddle without your help, eh?

choices.text: Back it up, Paimon. Listen to yourself!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're super cool, so Mora up front.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: "Louis, Louis!" ...Ah! You scared me half to death there!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: So, have you changed your mind, or are you just here to say hello?

choices.text: To say hello, and help while we're at it.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hoohroo~

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Haha. That's wonderful, then. Let us get started!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Alright then, best of luck!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Hmm... Next up, an Iktomisaurus under the moonlight! Yes, that sounds good. Getting the ideal lighting is going to take some work, though.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: #Hmm... Aha! It's your time to shine, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, my little friend!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Little? Pfft. He's nearly taller than you, Paimon'll have you know!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrwar? Roo?

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Very good, very good... The timing's perfect... Haha! My masterpiece is almost complete...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then make sure you get a good shot, just like the subject's one of your Fontainian girls! Hehe, that's how the line goes, right?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Hrooo, rroooh!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Haha, just relax!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: This angle! This moonlight Ah! Ah! Simply perfecto!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Just a moment, let me see... I'll need two more light sources. One needs to light up the Iktomisaurus's profile, so we get that contrast between warm light and the backdrop of night... That's how we'll create an air of mystery.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: And the other light source needs to illuminate the Saurian's silhouette. Not for any complicated reasons, but it is a necessity.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Yes, yes... That's what we're looking for! Just like a dream...

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: What the... Drat!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, but perhaps the atmospheric elemental concentration here differs from that in Fontaine. Something must've gone wrong with the machine... But no rush, everyone. Let me check.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: *humming* Hmm... Not here... Not here either...

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Dammit, dammit, damn it all! Gah! You sickened blackguard, you cosseted, coddled nincompoop! Arrrgh!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: You... You...!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hey, calm down!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Phew... Well... It's a goner now, isn't it?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Heh. Don't look at me like that. If nothing else, I feel better now!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: *sigh* Well, it's as you see. Our artificial lighting is broken — and after all that Mora I spent on it, too. Disappointing. Just like my ex-wife...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright, just... stop for now. Chill out, and don't panic. We're here to help!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: *sigh* I'm sorry... Phew. Alright. What do I need? Ah, yes. I need to shine one light on the <color=#00E1FFFF>left side of the Iktomisaurus's face</color>, and the other on the <color=#00E1FFFF>contours of its back</color>.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No problem! Let's do this!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: And so, Magnifico begins tinkering with his Kamera once more, leaving you all to think about how to make a suitable light source...

choices.text: What's going on? You getting a divorce?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What!?

talks.objective: Complete the lighting setup for the shoot

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Go work on the lighting. I don't require any help over here.

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Light up the left side of its face, as well as the outline of its back!</color>

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Haha, good, good! Come now, my little model, stay still... Yes, you're so very clever! Three, two, one, say cheese!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Ah, would you look at that? A masterpiece? And whose work is it? Yes, mine — Magnifico de la Magnificans!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Thank you, thank you so much! Haha! Now then, here's the balance I owe you! Ah... and this too. Look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, a final payment...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... Of only one Mora?

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Great... And now, our true protagonists are about to make an appearance! Come on in, don't be shy! You're a star, so make that entrance dazzle!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Phew, and that's a wrap! Here, take this copy as a gift... and know that you have obtained this masterpiece before any Fontainian gallery could!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, the final payment...

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: I'll be heading to this location next... Here, let me mark it out on your map. Who knows, perhaps our next meeting might be just around the corner!

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: And when it comes, I might even need your help once more!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, you're practically taking us for granted, aren't you?

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: Well, our meeting wasn't for me to decide. T'was fate — yes, fate! — that brought us together.

response.speaker: Magnifico
response.text: See you, and good luck, my friends!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Raaawr!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Magnifico picks up his luggage and leaps into a hot-air balloon.\nYou watch the balloon first shake violently, causing him to give a hearty laugh. Then it quickly regains stability before floating far away.

choices.text: Doesn't look like it'll be worth much Mora...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wrooh? Wroo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah... Paimon's disappointed too... She thought the final payment would be more substantial than the deposit...

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Wait... Why did you disappear when the Iktomisaurus showed up? And why did it disappear once you returned?

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: Could it be that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #That's right, {M#he}{F#she} went off to the bathroom!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, just think about it. We couldn't all go at the same time, could we? That'd be awkward — and embarrassing, too!

dialogues.speaker: Magnifico
dialogues.text: #Oh, yeah, right... Haha, of course! {NICKNAME} couldn't turn into a Saurian! Surely not! Not that it'd be a bad thing, of course.
